{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column
print("Original revenue types:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample of revenue:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_parsed'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the parsed column
print("Parsed revenue sample:", df['revenue_parsed'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter: only completed orders, exclude QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & 
               (df['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99)]

# Check the cleaned data
print(f"Cleaned data shape: {df_clean.shape}")

# Now compute average revenue per order by channel and customer_segment
df_grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)
print("Average revenue per order by channel and segment:")
print(df_grouped)

# Return the grouped results for later use
print("\nGrouped data:")
df_grouped.to_csv('grouped_revenue.csv')
print(df_grouped)"}
